prompt: As of August 3rd 2024, which movie using the Technicolor dye-transfer process was the last to win the Academy Award for Best Picture?
answer: As of August 3, 2024, the last Best Picture winner made using the Technicolor dye-transfer process was **_The Godfather Part II_ (1974)**. It won Best Picture at the **47th Academy Awards in 1975**.
